chroma_key.name: cyan
chroma_key.selection_reason: highest 1st-percentile subject distance among the 3 candidate(s) clearing the 96 erase radius

idle.action: standing still facing viewer; subtle breathing squash-and-stretch and one blink; leaf sways gently; feet planted

walk.action: side-view walk cycle facing right; stubby yellow feet alternate contact clearly, body bobs slightly, leaf bounces; smooth continuous loop

wave.action: friendly greeting: raises one flipper hand and waves left-right, eyes happy closed arcs, returns to idle pose on last frame

sleep.action: sitting down asleep; eyes closed, head droops lower each frame, a small 'Zz' bubble may appear; gentle slow breathing

drag.action: being lifted/carried in mid-air: body hangs limp, feet dangle, flippers up, wide surprised eyes; slight swinging motion

celebrate.action: joyful celebration: crouch, hop up with flippers raised high, happy closed eyes, land back to idle; tiny sparkles allowed near hands

style: clean flat vector-style mascot illustration, thick uniform dark-brown outline, soft pastel fills, plain solid background
